name: default
description: Shared fleet automation backbone: the observe-only fleet.attention Line (posts unjudged anomalies to cruxible next) and the fleet.check Runbook.

min_severity.description: Minimum anomaly severity posted to the Line inbox.

name: telemetry
description: One hub's telemetry ingest Line (EWMA gain filter + approved-baseline classifier), its capture-landing sensor-health and anomaly-ingest Lines, and their observations-only Mandates. Adopt once per hub export.

name.description: Short identifier for this hub export (Line suffix and logical source suffix).

relative_path.description: Workspace-relative path of the hub telemetry JSON batch.

alpha.description: EWMA smoothing gain in (0, 1]. Lower values absorb sharper transient spikes.

min_breach_samples.description: Consecutive filtered samples outside approved bounds required to classify a fault.

flatline_samples.description: Consecutive identical samples required to mark a sensor degraded (flatlined).

max_heartbeat_age_s.description: Maximum heartbeat age in seconds before marking a sensor offline (default 1800 = 30 min).

expires.description: How long each observations-only Mandate stays valid (36h, 90d, 12w, 1y).
